This role is based at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn. AIOS is at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We're the world's fastest growing AI doctor. We're faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy. We're profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider. Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We'll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. Being a Marshal at Bolt Pharmacy We are building a world-class team. As a Marshal at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to keep our pharmacy floor moving—so patients get the treatment they're counting on. You'll own your area of the warehouse, keeping packing stations stocked and packers supported. You'll anticipate what's needed, respond quickly and tackle bottlenecks before they interrupt the flow. Every minute matters. You'll bring precision to the pace. From matching medication strengths to orders and protecting the cold chain to spotting stock discrepancies, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll keep your area clear, organised and ready for the next order. Working alongside packers, fellow Marshals and shift leadership, you'll help Bolt Pharmacy deliver more as we grow. You'll take initiative, flag problems early and step in where the team needs you. Your impact is hands-on, immediate and felt in every order that leaves the building. Great performance means packers get a response within 3 minutes, packing runs without avoidable interruptions and medicines stay protected. Your area consistently meets our safety and housekeeping standards, and colleagues can count on you every shift. This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working shifts to support warehouse operations. You'll report to our Shift Lead and Site Operations Lead. You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's packing and warehouse operations team, including packers and fellow Marshals. Key responsibilities Keep packing flowing: Patrol your area, respond to packer requests within 3 minutes and replenish medicines and consumables before supplies run out. Get medication control right: Supply only one medication strength and one matching stack of orders per packing table at a time, verifying the match before replenishing. Protect the cold chain: Follow cold-chain procedures and Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements, returning temperature-controlled medicines to the fridge immediately when no longer needed. Handle medicines safely: Use designated holding areas, never leave medicines unattended in walkways or packing areas, and immediately quarantine damaged or suspect stock for Shift Lead review. Keep the floor safe and ready: Clear cardboard, keep stations tidy and exits unobstructed, remove immediate hazards and report concerns promptly. Operate equipment only within your training and authorisation. Work as one team: Support fellow Marshals, cover neighbouring areas during breaks and promptly flag stock discrepancies or rotation errors. Need to have Warehouse knowledge: You understand warehouse operations, stock control, Health & Safety and GDP requirements, and put them into practice. Attention to detail: You check medication strengths, order matches and storage conditions carefully. Accuracy is essential. Ownership: You stay organised, anticipate what's needed and manage your area independently as priorities change. Teamwork: You communicate clearly, flag issues early and bring reliable, consistent effort to every shift. A hands-on approach: You can fulfil the role's physical duties, including continuous on-foot activity and routine manual handling. Nice to have Regulated operations: You've worked in regulated warehousing, logistics, pharmacy or healthcare. Cold-chain knowledge: You understand how to handle temperature-controlled medicines and protect them throughout the packing process. Warehouse systems: You've used warehouse management tools to track stock and identify discrepancies. Equipment qualifications: You hold forklift or pump truck certification, or baler sign-off. If you don't, we'll provide training. Our cultural standards We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members: Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it. 🎯 "You just build a f**ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take." Compensation & Benefits Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build. Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off. Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role. Benefits The stuff below is cool as well. Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills. Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing. GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable. Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy. Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm. What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

review_candidates.description: About Pacific Fusion Pacific Fusion was founded in 2023 with the mission to power the world with abundant, affordable, clean energy. We are rapidly designing and building a pulser-driven inertial fusion system to achieve net facility gain (more fusion energy output than stored energy input). In parallel, we are developing the key components required to build affordable fusion systems. Our plans are ambitious. We have raised over $900M so far from incredible investors, resourcing us to deliver on these plans. We are bringing together the best scientists, engineers, and operators from the fusion community, hard tech industry, and other sectors. We are united by a shared sense of urgency to provide clean power for the world, particularly managing climate change while meeting growing global energy demand. You can read more about us in this letter from our founders. Why This Role Matters The Manufacturing Systems Analyst is responsible for the end-to-end ownership of software systems within their assigned portfolio, including vendor management, licensing, user administration, and system configuration. This role partners closely with integration stakeholders and the PLM Administrator to ensure data quality and governance across components and BOMs, and owns the Manufacturing Workflow, including the associated business process, within the system landscape. What You'll Do System & Vendor Ownership Serve as the primary business owner for assigned software systems, acting as the main point of contact for internal stakeholders and external vendors Manage vendor relationships including contract renewals, escalations, and performance reviews Own software licensing: procurement, allocation, renewals, and cost optimization Administer user access and permissions, including provisioning, deactivation, and periodic access reviews Perform system configuration changes as needed to support business requirements (within defined scope; complex configuration/customization routed to appropriate technical resources) Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with integration stakeholders/teams to define, prioritize, and validate integration requirements between owned systems and downstream/upstream platforms Work with the PLM Administrator to establish and enforce data quality standards and governance policies for component and BOM data Act as liaison between business stakeholders and the broader Enterprise Systems team on cross-system dependencies Data Quality & Governance Support governance processes ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness of component and BOM data across systems Identify and remediate data quality issues in coordination with the PLM Administrator Contribute to defining data standards, naming conventions, and audit processes for components/BOMs Manufacturing Process Ownership Own the design, configuration, and continuous improvement of the Manufacturing Workflow and its underlying business process Ensure the workflow and process align with manufacturing operations requirements and evolve with business needs Troubleshoot workflow issues and coordinate resolution with technical/vendor support as needed What You Bring Bachelors degree in Business, Information Systems, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered Experience administering enterprise software systems (MES or related manufacturing systems preferred) General understanding of PLM concepts (e.g., components, BOMs) sufficient to collaborate effectively with the PLM Administrator Familiarity with vendor and license management practices Experience with system configuration and user access administration Understanding of BOM/component data structures and data governance principles Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; comfortable working with technical and business stakeholders Experience in a manufacturing or OEM environment is a plus Pay Range $133,000—$199,400 USD Total Compensation And Benefits For Eligible Employees Industry-competitive salary Equity plan 6% employer 401k matching Generous paid time off (including sick leave, vacation, paid family leave) Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance Actual base salary offered will be determined by: experience, skills, and work location. This range is for base salary, our total compensation includes equity and benefits. We welcome you to apply even if your expectations are outside our listed range. EQUAL OPPORTUNTITY Pacific Fusion is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Pacific Fusion is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures and throughout employment. If you need assistance or any accommodation, please let us know. U.S. EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE This position may require access to information or technology that is subject to U.S. export control laws, such as ITAR or EAR. Under these regulations, we are required to ensure that such access is provided only to individuals who are classified as 'U.S. Persons.'This status includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending. RECRUITING AGENCIES Pacific Fusion does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies without a fully executed recruitment agreement in place. In the absence of such agreement, Pacific Fusion reserves the right to pursue and hire any candidates without an obligation to pay fees. Agencies are requested not to contact Pacific Fusion hiring managers or employees regarding recruiting services.

Working closely with regional and country sales teams, functional stakeholders, and business leaders across the network, you will lead customer development activities, coordinate complex sales opportunities, and ensure the successful implementation of new business. You will play a key role in strengthening customer partnerships, increasing revenue and profitability, and positioning DHL as the preferred logistics partner across global markets. How will you contribute to the success of DHL? Develop and maintain global, regional, and country account strategies aligned with business objectives and Customer Development Plans. Build and manage strong relationships with customer decision-makers, influencers, and key DHL stakeholders. Identify, qualify, and manage revenue growth opportunities through the sales pipeline. Develop compelling value propositions that address customer needs and business challenges. Lead customer presentations, proposals, and commercial discussions to secure new business. Ensure alignment on solutions and service expectations across customers, regions, countries, and DHL business units. Coordinate and monitor the successful implementation of new business opportunities and customer agreements. Functionally lead cross-functional virtual account teams across Europe and, when required, globally. Drive collaboration between sales, operations, customer service, and other key stakeholders to deliver customer objectives. Monitor account performance and take appropriate actions to achieve revenue and profitability targets. Analyze customer needs, market trends, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities. Increase customer value and DHL's share of wallet through strategic account development. Share customer insights, account updates, and opportunities with regional, global, and country stakeholders. Maintain accurate account plans, sales pipeline data, activity tracking, and revenue reporting in line with defined sales processes. Travel up to 70% to meet customers, support account development activities, coach teams, and engage with country organizations. Do you have what it takes? Strong consultative selling and solution-based sales capabilities. Excellent sales knowledge and commercial acumen. Experience managing global or multinational customers within an international business environment. Strong strategic thinking and decision-making skills. Ability to influence senior stakeholders and executive decision-makers. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong customer focus and commitment to delivering exceptional service. Ability to build and maintain relationships across complex, matrixed organizations. Experience leading and coordinating cross-functional and virtual teams. Self-motivated, results-oriented professional who can work independently and collaboratively. The opportunity to drive business growth and influence key commercial decisions. Exposure to senior customer stakeholders and leadership teams across the DHL network. An international and dynamic working environment with extensive cross-functional collaboration. The chance to work with industry-leading customers across multiple sectors and markets. Ownership of complex sales opportunities and high-impact customer development initiatives. A collaborative culture focused on customer success, innovation, and growth. Professional development and career advancement opportunities within the world's leading logistics company. Competitive compensation and benefits package. A role where you can make a measurable impact on customer satisfaction, revenue growth, and business performance.
